[c1] You are further acknowledging that you are aware of ESD’s agency-wide Minority and Women Business Enterprise (‘MWBE’) utilization goal of 30% and ESD's agency wide Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business ('SDVOB') utilization goal of 6%. Please note that each project will be assigned an individual contract-specific goal, which may be higher or lower than the 30% and 6%, respectively.
[c2] Q_2365 By entering your name in the box below, you are acknowledging that ESD’s Contractor & Supplier Diversity policy will apply to this project. You are further acknowledging that you are aware of ESD’s agency-wide Minority and Women Business Enterprise (‘MWBE’) utilization goal of 30% and ESD's agency wide Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business ('SDVOB') utilization goal of 6%.
[c3] Please note that each project will be assigned an individual contract-specific goal, which may be higher or lower than the 30% and 6%, respectively. Furthermore, you understand that, should this project receive a funding award, the Applicant shall be required to use good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed MWBE and SDVOB goals assigned to this project and failure to attain MWBE and SDVOB goals could result in grant amount being reduced.
[c4] Furthermore, you understand that, should this project receive a funding award, the Applicant shall be required to use good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed MWBE and SDVOB goals assigned to this project and failure to attain MWBE and SDVOB goals could result in grant amount being reduced. Q_4182 By entering your name in the box below, you certify and agree that you are aware that your award will be reduced in proportion to the reduction of jobs and/or total project costs.

checks.explanation: The excerpts document only that applicants must acknowledge ESD’s "agency-wide Minority and Women Business Enterprise ('MWBE') utilization goal of 30%" and that "each project will be assigned an individual contract-specific goal, which may be higher or lower than the 30%." They also state that, if awarded, the applicant must use "good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed MWBE and SDVOB goals assigned to this project." This does not establish an original public pledge, proposal term, or conditional commitment by the applicant to "meet or exceed" the 30% goal specifically.

findings.summary: The application acknowledgment says ESD’s Contractor & Supplier Diversity policy applies to the project; the applicant acknowledges ESD’s agency-wide MWBE utilization goal of 30% and SDVOB goal of 6%; each project will later receive an individual contract-specific goal that may be higher or lower than those percentages; and, if funded, the applicant must use good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed project-assigned goals, with possible grant reduction for failure to attain them.
findings.explanation: This passage directly states the governing terms. It does not say the applicant promised its own utilization goals would meet or exceed 30%; instead it says the applicant acknowledges ESD’s agency-wide goals, that project-specific goals may differ, and that the obligation is good faith efforts toward the assigned goals if funding is awarded.
findings.excerpt: Q_2365 By entering your name in the box below, you are acknowledging that ESD’s Contractor & Supplier Diversity policy will apply to this project. You are further acknowledging that you are aware of ESD’s agency-wide Minority and Women Business Enterprise (‘MWBE’) utilization goal of 30% and ESD's agency wide Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Business ('SDVOB') utilization goal of 6%. Please note that each project will be assigned an individual contract-specific goal, which may be higher or lower than the 30% and 6%, respectively. Furthermore, you understand that, should this project receive a funding award, the Applicant shall be required to use good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed MWBE and SDVOB goals assigned to this project and failure to attain MWBE and SDVOB goals could result in grant amount being reduced.

findings.summary: ESD’s program guidelines state that the agency-wide MWBE utilization goal is 30%, that after application approval a project may be assigned an individual contract-specific goal higher or lower than 30%, and that where goals are set the grantee must use good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed project MWBE goals and maintain records needed to demonstrate compliance with Article 15-A.
findings.explanation: This independent guideline confirms the same program structure and clarifies that the relevant obligation is to pursue whatever project-specific goal is assigned, not necessarily 30%.
findings.excerpt: Please note that ESD’s agency-wide MWBE utilization goal is 30%. After application approval the project may be assigned an individual contract-specific goal, which may be higher or lower than 30%. In instances where goals are set, grantee will be required to use good faith efforts to achieve the prescribed MWBE goals assigned to the project and must maintain such records and take such actions necessary to demonstrate compliance with Article 15-A of the New York State Executive Law.

findings.summary: For projects subject to MWBE requirements, the recipient must submit periodic MWBE Compliance & Payment Reports documenting progress made toward achievement of the MWBE project goals.
findings.explanation: This establishes a reporting mechanism for tracking progress toward assigned project MWBE goals, but it does not show any project-specific goal or actual utilization for the applicant.
findings.excerpt: Recipient is required to submit a periodic MWBE Compliance & Payment Report to OCSD by the 10th day following either the end of each (i) month, for construction contracts in excess of $100,000, or (ii) quarter, for services and commodities contracts in excess of $25,000, over the term of the project documenting the progress made toward achievement of the MWBE project goals.

findings.summary: Where MWBE goals have been established, the recipient must document good faith efforts to provide meaningful MWBE participation as subcontractors or suppliers in performing the project.
findings.explanation: This provides an explicit limitation/condition: the good-faith-efforts documentation duty applies where MWBE goals have been established.
findings.excerpt: Where MWBE goals have been established herein, pursuant to 5 NYCRR §142.8, Recipient must document “Good Faith Efforts” to provide meaningful participation by MWBEs as subcontractors or suppliers in the performance of the project.

selection.gap: No verified passage shows that the applicant itself committed that its minority, women, and service-disabled veteran utilization goals would meet or exceed 30%. The supplied sources instead show acknowledgment of ESD’s agency-wide 30% MWBE goal and 6% SDVOB goal, later assignment of project-specific goals that may be higher or lower, and a duty to use good faith efforts toward assigned goals.
